exception_path.label: conflict
exception_path.reason: Staff follow the procedure in front of them, and when it leaves out an exception the policy grants they end up refusing customers the policy allows.

older_version.label: conflict
older_version.reason: A branch that can still open the older version can still follow it, and that makes it a live conflict until it's archived.

role_generic.label: conflict
role_generic.reason: Approval authority has to name one role, and a general word like manager lets an assistant manager or a head teller approve when the policy only meant the branch manager.

unit.label: conflict
unit.reason: Ten days and ten business days can be four days apart, and a deadline staff give a customer has to mean one thing everywhere it's written.

note: The specialist's decisions on the experts' four disagreements. They were made in one session on 10/29, and they produced version 2 of the answer key.
